title: C4OS Grill Question 015 - Plugin Icon Reordering

questions.label: Where should users reorder plugin icons?
questions.help: Recommended: Settings only for v1. Header drag/drop adds pointer and layout edge cases; Settings gives a clearer configuration surface.
options: Both Settings and direct header drag/drop

questions.label: Where should users change a plugin icon's left/right side?
questions.help: Recommended: Settings only, because side placement is persistent user-global plugin configuration.
options: Both Settings and direct header drag/drop

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether plugin icons need separators, pinned positions, hidden icons, or per-plugin default positions.
